title: Japanese-Style Mushroom Onigiri
description: A twist on the classic Japanese rice ball, filled with sautéed mushrooms and served as a snack or light meal. This recipe showcases the earthy flavors of mushrooms and the simplicity of Japanese cuisine.
instructions: Prepare the Japanese rice according to the package instructions.
Sauté the mushrooms in a pan with a little oil until they're tender and fragrant.
In a small saucepan, combine soy sauce, rice vinegar, sugar, and salt. Bring to a boil over medium heat, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Once the rice is cooked, allow it to cool slightly. Mix in the soy sauce mixture and mushrooms.
Wet your hands with water and shape the rice mixture into small triangles or cylinders.
Serve the onigiri with additional soy sauce or pickled ginger, if desired.
